subject: Security platform renewal — decision timeline & action items
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security platform renewal — decision timeline & action items

Team,

Quick summary — our Drata pilot contract is up for renewal in mid-June (quote attached). Vanta has proactively reached out with a renewal package as well, and Trust Center has a new integration offering that would plug into parts of our customer portal. We need a short internal decision process to lock one vendor and a target date for procurement to start the contracting work.

Questions / asks:
- Laura/Monica: given audit schedule and SOC 2 evidence needs, which vendor meets the minimum automation and controls we need? See attached Drata_feature-gap-table.xlsx I asked engineering to fill.
- Aditya/Hannah: procurement timeline and approvals — if we pick Drata or Vanta, what’s the latest PO/contract start date to guarantee coverage through July? Any preferenced payment/term constraints?
- I'll set a decision deadline of 2026-05-14 unless anyone flags a blocker.

Attachments: Drata_quote_20260504.pdf, Vanta_renewal_20260501.xlsx

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security platform renewal — decision timeline & action items

Vivek —

Thanks for the note. Quick thoughts from compliance:
- Drata: stronger automation for evidence collection and continuous monitoring. Their roadmap matches our desire to reduce manual evidence collection for infra and app controls.
- Vanta: solid product, faster UI, but we've seen more manual items in our last proof-of-concept.
- Trust Center: interesting for customer-facing trust pages, but it doesn't replace a full compliance automation platform. Useful as a complement.

Pros/cons (high level):
- Automation & engineering lift: Drata > Vanta > Trust Center
- Contract complexity: Vanta templates are cleaner; Drata's SOW has a couple of clauses procurement/legal will want redlined.
- Time to evidence for upcoming audit (Aug): Drata gives the best runway.

Request: can someone set a 30-minute vendor demo with Sam from Drata (I can drive technical Qs)? I added a short feature-gap table (attached) with items engineering filled out.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security platform renewal — decision timeline & action items

Callouts from procurement side:
- Target: If we make a decision by 2026-05-14 we can get PO + payment terms in place by 2026-05-28 and avoid gap. Latest start we can tolerate is 2026-06-05 to avoid lapsed coverage.
- Discounts: ask vendors for multi-year vs annual pricing. Historically we can get 10-18% on year-1 if we commit 24 months.
- Data residency / DPA: Monica, please flag any non-negotiable DPA points early so I can drive them in parallel.

I'll reach out to our sourcing contact to pull the preferred clause list and will draft a procurement checklist with required legal/infosec signoffs.

- Aditya
Procurement Manager
From: Sam Reed <sam.reed@drata.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-05T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security platform renewal — decision timeline & action items

Hi Vivek / team —

Thanks for the convo. Happy to move quickly. A few items from our side:
- I've attached an updated quote with a 12% discount for a 24-month commitment (Drata_quote_20260504.pdf).
- We can start onboarding the compliance evidence connectors within 2 weeks of contract signature; suggested SSO integration window is ~3 weeks.
- SOW and DPA: I can share a standard SOW and our DPA; if you send redlines we'll accept most commercial redlines or escalate legal exceptions.

DocuSign link for the SOW/quote (preview): https://docusign.com/sign/ABC-Drata-SOW-2026
HubSpot deal id: 384

Happy to schedule a demo with Laura on Wed 5/6 10:00am PT — does that work?

Best,
Sam Reed
Enterprise Sales, Drata
sam.reed@drata.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reed <sam.reed@drata.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T16:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security platform renewal — decision timeline & action items

Sam / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on pricing. A few legal/security items that will impact timing:
- Data processing & residency: we need confirmation that account-level logs and customer data are stored only in US and encrypted at rest with keys we control (KMS support).
- Subprocessor list: provide current subprocessor SOC 2 reports and notice windows for changes.
- DPA redlines: attached Drata_DPA_redlines.docx — please review. The redlines are mostly standard: notification timelines, breach reporting SLA, and audit cooperation.

If Drata can accept the DPA redlines with minor edits, we can stay on the 2026-05-28 onboarding timeline. If not, procurement/legal will need an extra sprint to negotiate.

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Sam Reed <sam.reed@drata.com>
Date: 2026-05-07T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security platform renewal — decision timeline & action items

Thanks all — quick summary and action items:
- Decision date: 2026-05-14. If no objections, proceed with Drata 24-month offer (12% discount) as preferred vendor.
- Action owners:
  - Laura: run demo with Drata (Sam) and validate the engineering feature-gap items (owner: Laura) — due 2026-05-06 (demo scheduled).
  - Monica: finalize DPA redlines and send to Sam by 2026-05-08.
  - Aditya: prepare PO template and procurement checklist; start PO process if DPA accepted — due 2026-05-11.
  - Vivek: confirm contract approval path with finance and schedule kickoff for onboarding week of 2026-05-31 if things go green.

If anyone foresees a blocker to the May 14 decision, flag it here today. Otherwise I’ll treat silence as agreement and move to lock Drata and start contracting.

Vivek
